# John Le Maistre

John Le Maistre is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2013.

John Le Maistre has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2007 Grouville Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre#e8)

  Not elected.
- [**2013 Grouville Connétable By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre#e17)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville with 69.4% of the vote.
- [**2014 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre#e21)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville unopposed.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/john-le-maistre/)
- [**2018 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre#e43)

  Elected as Connétable of Grouville unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/john-le-maistre-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H7Lfc8Z9nO8)

## Election History

### 2007 Grouville Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) (1 seat), 25th July 2007.

**John Le Maistre was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy)** |  | 1,040 | 61.9% |
| 2 | John Le Maistre |  | 641 | 38.1% |

1,681 votes

3,160 registered voters

= 53.2% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._

### 2013 Grouville Connétable By-Election

By-election following the death of [Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy) in July 2013. (1 seat), 2nd October 2013.

**John Le Maistre was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2013**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **John Le Maistre** |  | 1,001 | 69.4% |
| 2 | [Charles Dix](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/charles-dix) |  | 442 | 30.6% |

1,443 votes

Unknown registered voters
